intro: The Broken Pillar is a weathered cluster of ancient troll ruins jutting from the dunes south of Gadgetzan. It serves as an isolated research post for the goblin prospector and scientist Marvon Rivetseeker, who studies the enigmatic artifacts buried beneath the surrounding sands.

p: Rising out of the sands south of Gadgetzan and east of the treacherous Abyssal Sands, the Broken Pillar marks the remnants of ancient troll architecture long swallowed by Tanaris. Despite the desolate surroundings and encroaching desert beasts, the site offers rare clues to the continent's prehistoric civilisations. Marvon Rivetseeker, a goblin researcher originally based out of Ratchet, has established a lonely camp beside the shattered stonework to examine curious relics known as Gahz'ridian scattered across the waste.
